name: Motorised tools & small appliances
note: Operation groups move between plants together. Costs are illustrative defaults; users edit them.

groups.name: Motor-fan assembly
operations: stamp rotor laminations from silicon steel
stack laminations and wind the rotor
press-fit the fan to the motor spindle

groups.name: PCBA (SMT)
operations: SMT placement and reflow of the printed circuit board assembly

groups.name: Heating element
operations: wind resistance wire around a core fitted with ceramic pipes
insert the core into a mica-insulated metal tube

groups.name: Housing moulding
operations: injection-mould the housing shells and covers

groups.name: Switch, wiring and minor parts
operations: make the switch, wiring, supports and fasteners

precedent.note: Kept apart from the power cord (D330). In the third space heater of N347421 the switches came from China with the fan blades and thermostat, while the housing, heating element, motor and power cord came from Vietnam; CBP held Vietnam. The id keeps its old name so stored plans, fixtures and BOM imports still load.

groups.name: Power cord, knobs and covers
operations: mould the knobs and the back cover

precedent.note: Split from the switch and wiring (D330). In all three space heaters of N347421 the power cord came from a different country than the switches; in the second, the knobs were moulded in Vietnam with the other plastic items. Making the cord, nuts, bolts and housing in Cambodia was not enough when the motor, switches, fan and heating element came from China (N347421, first heater). In N342916 the power cord assembly came from China while the switch plate and all plastic parts were made in Thailand, which CBP held the origin.

groups.name: Final assembly
operations: connect wiring, mount the PCBA and motor, close the housing
